title: Some Horrors
description: A small horror modpack for Minecraft
body:
This is a relatively small modpack that contains horror mods for Minecraft, multiplayer compatability is functional yet may be unstable so be careful if you use this for multiplayer, and the essentials mod was added to help aid with multiplayer in the event that you do want to play multiplayer.


Curseforge mods included:

[A Night Stalker](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/a-night-stalker)

[The Imitators](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-imitators-legacy)

[The Hybrid](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-hybrid)

[Siren Head: The Arrival](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/siren-head-the-arrival)

[Configured](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured)

[Catalogue](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/catalogue)

[The Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest)


Due to the Siren Head: The Arrival mod I also had to change the license so please make sure to check that out, also make sure to check out all the curseforge mod liscenses to make sure you know what they are just in case.
